field.name: top-a_overlap
field.label: Overlap
field.description: Some UIkit themes use richer styles, including textured backgrounds and borders. In this case, you can add the .uk-section-overlap class, to apply a border image and a negative offset to the following section. Note that this only works in styles that implement the feature, if there are subsequent sections.
